messages:
maria_cs: Quick sync — Atlas Mobile (acct AT-992) onboarding: they hit a burst of preflight 429s during app coldstart. Theyre anxious about GA next week. Can we triage?

alex_eng: Thanks for the heads-up. Do we have a sample request pattern and logs? Is this preflight or actual generation calls?

maria_cs: Preflight (ephemeral token flow). They reported ~12 concurrent preflight calls from app init. Sample log: 
```
2026-03-22T14:02:11Z GET /v1/preflight 429 X-RateLimit-Remaining:0 window=60
client: mobile-sdk/0.9.2 env: prod region: us-west-2
```

dev_support: That volume will definitely trigger our per-key preflight window. Two quick checks: 1) is the SDK adding jitter/coalescing? 2) any clock skew in headers?

maria_cs: SDK version is 0.9.2 (customer using our JS bundle embedded in RN). They also supplied a trace where header X-Client-Clock is off by ~-18s on some devices.

alex_eng: Clock drift explains duplicate preflight attempts + TTL mismatches. If a device believes token is expired it retries aggressively. Also 12 parallel inits without coalescing = thundering herd.

dev_support: Suggested customer fixes (to send to them):
- Sync device clock (ntp) or use server-time fallback in SDK.
- Add simple client-side jitter + capped exponential backoff on preflight.
Example: 
```
const MAX_RETRIES = 4
const BACKOFF = (i) => Math.min(1000 * 2**i + (Math.random()*300), 10000)
```
- Batch or serialize preflight on process startup if possible (single shared token).

prod_enablement: From our side I can temporarily relax their preflight window and enable preflight coalescing for the tenant while they push the client patch. @ops can you lift for 48h?

ops: On it. Temporarily increasing AT-992 preflight quota by 2x and enabling edge coalescing for the next 48 hours (until 2026-03-24T00:00:00Z). Will monitor 5m/1h error rates and revert if any downstream impact.

maria_cs: Perfect — I'll tell the customer to deploy the clock-sync + backoff patch and re-test. Also capturing feedback: they said the error messaging made it hard to tell whether the problem was auth vs rate limit (429 vs 401 confusion). They want clearer troubleshooting guidance in the quickstart.

alex_eng: Good feedback. I'll add a short "preflight gotchas" section to the quickstart: common causes (clock, parallel inits, missing jitter), sample backoff, and hints for what to check in our response headers.

maria_cs: Can someone create a docs ticket and link it to CS-1248 so we have traceability for the renewal conversation? If we don't unblock this this week their renewal sentiment drops.

onboard-bot: Ticket CS-1248 created: "quickstart: preflight troubleshooting & sample backoff". Assigned to alex_eng/docs.

dev_support: Action items summary:
- ops: temp lift + coalescing (done).
- maria_cs: push customer to patch and confirm once they roll.
- alex_eng: update quickstart page + include backoff snippet.
- eng: investigate whether we can auto-coalesce by API-key in edge for longer for onboarding accounts.

maria_cs: Thanks team — I'll update the customer and report back here after their canary. :thumbsup:
